item: CI prints the installed package versions at the end of the test and Core-only jobs, on red as well as green, so a tail-limited log reader sees the environment (R364)
summary: The comparison that found the pytest 9.2.0 cause (R349) was rebuilt from short sibling jobs because the install step prints its packages at the head of a long log and the only available reader returns the last 5000 lines. The test job and the Core-only job now end with a step named Installed versions (kept on red as well as green): if always(), python -m pip list --format=freeze plus the Python patch version, the runner image and the kernel, tee'd into GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. In test it sits straight after the pytest step and before the bandit and pip-audit installs, so it lists the environment the tests ran in. Size, INFERRED from a uv pip compile of the same extras (108 and 87 packages): about 112 lines and 2.0 KB in test, 91 lines and 1.6 KB in Core-only, about 6 KB of log with timestamps and the script echo; the measured figure is in the PR body. tests/test_ci_installed_versions_step.py pins the step (once per job, if always(), the freeze command, the summary, straight after the last pytest step) and names seven mutants per job. Riding along (R221, test-only): the two test files that spelled the pre-check sentence out (tests/test_typed_key_routes_scrub.py, tests/test_country_data_auto_start.py) now import NETWORK_REFUSED. STATED LIMIT: it lists the packages, it does not say which moved; the portability, columnar, crypto and other lanes are not covered.
